build.buildCommand: COMPOSER_ALLOW_SUPERUSER=1 composer update --no-dev --no-interaction --optimize-autoloader --no-scripts && npm install && npm run build

deploy.startCommand: export DB_HOST=$PGHOST && export DB_PORT=$PGPORT && export DB_DATABASE=$PGDATABASE && export DB_USERNAME=$PGUSER && export DB_PASSWORD=$PGPASSWORD && export DB_CONNECTION=pgsql && rm -f backend/bootstrap/cache/*.php && php artisan package:discover --ansi && php artisan migrate --force && php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=$PORT
